# Emoji artwork and data

Source: emoji-datasource-apple 16.0.0, https://github.com/iamcal/emoji-data

The Unicode-to-sprite map is derived from the package's MIT-licensed data. See LICENSE.data. The Apple clean 32px image sheet was converted to WebP for transfer size; coordinates retain the original 34px cell spacing and 1px inset.

Apple emoji artwork is Copyright © Apple Inc. The upstream project states that Apple images are not licensed for commercial usage. Its MIT data license does not license the Apple artwork. No Apple font files are included.
